writeup: Woot has the eufy Security S300 eufyCam 3C 2-camera kit with HomeBase 3 (model T8881121) for $99.99. Two in-stock retailers, Citrustech Distribution and Grand Stock Electronics, both list the same kit at $299.99, so this is about 66% less. The cameras record in 4K, run up to 180 days per charge, and need no monthly fee. Woot showed only one left at last check, and the item's condition isn't stated on the listing.
